name: Coos County Pipeline

values.OtherEnglishNames: Coos Bay Pipeline; Coos Bay Project

researcher_notes: The Coos Bay Project is in the EIA pipeline projects workbook released August 2026, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 355. It lists a new intrastate pipeline built by Coos County Pipeline Co in Oregon, 72.4 miles, 4, 6 and 12 inch, completed in 2004. A November 2002 Federal Register notice from the Bureau of Land Management describes the same line: a 12 inch pipeline from near Roseburg to Coos Bay, about 60 miles on the main line, applied for by the Coos County Board of Commissioners, with 4 and 6 inch laterals to Coquille, Myrtle Point and perhaps Bandon. A July 1999 trade report from Natural Gas Intelligence says the line would be owned by Coos County and fed from a Williams Northwest interconnect at Roseburg. The line is already built, so the build-step test is met. Length of 72.4 miles is far above the 25 km minimum. It is not an existing row: the only Coos Bay entry in the roster is P0237 Pacific Connector, a different cancelled 36 inch line from Malin to the Jordan Cove terminal. No other roster row is near Roseburg. The line is intrastate, so no FERC filing is expected. Not found: a state regulator document or operator release confirming the 2004 in-service date and current operator, and any capacity figure. The owner name follows the EIA spelling, and no matching entity exists yet. The 2004 date is the EIA completion date and the Federal Register and trade sources are pre-construction, so only the EIA workbook confirms the built line and the tier is medium. Route not researched: RouteAccuracy should be no route until Oregon or Coos County GIS data is checked.
